instruments.notes: WTI-based oil-price collars, weighted average floor and ceiling; position as of March 1, 2001 for 2001 production
instruments.evidence_quote:
As  of  March  1,  2001,  we  had entered into derivative contracts for 3.9
million  barrels  of  2001  production  using  WTI-based  oil-price  collars  to
establish  a  weighted  average  floor  price of $28.11 per barrel and a ceiling
price  of $31.13 per barrel.

instruments.notes: WTI-based oil-price swaps, weighted average fixed price; contracts associated with 2001 production
instruments.evidence_quote:
2001  production for 450,000 barrels using WTI-based oil-price swaps and 600,000
barrels  using  Dated  Brent-based oil-price swaps to establish weighted average
fixed  prices of $26.89 per barrel for WTI and $24.31 for Dated Brent.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: From time to time uses swaps, collars and options with creditworthy counterparties to reduce oil price risk and underpin planned revenues; no trading purposes.
